title: Hippocrates Green Juice
excerpt: For a 20 oz. serving of green juice, simply juice and combine:5 oz. sunflower sprouts5 oz. pea sprouts5 oz. cucumber5 oz. celery
content:
For a 20 oz. serving of green juice, simply juice and combine:

  • 5 oz. sunflower sprouts

  • 5 oz. pea sprouts

  • 5 oz. cucumber

  • 5 oz. celery
